title: Welcome, Agent
body:
The case is open. Welcome to ORGT Assassin. On Nov 1 at 12:00 am the hunt begins, and every agent in the game will have a target.

Get ready:

  • Sign up by Oct 27 at 11:59 pm. Miss the deadline and you are sitting this one out.
  • Grab your weapon at ORGT from Oct 26 to Oct 30 during open Outpost hours. Only grab one.
  • Watch your inbox. Your target arrives by email before the game starts.
  • Learn the rules, especially the safe zones. Know where you are protected and where you are not.
  • Join the GroupMe. Announcements, surprises and safe objects for certain weeks are shared there and on this site.

Dispatches will land here every Friday at 9 pm with the latest from the field. Until then, trust no one, check behind you, and keep your eyes open.
